messages:
sam_docs: Quick sync  I'm drafting a concise v1->v2 migration guide focused on what breaks and quick fixes. Need owners for: JS+Py snippets, API reference banner, embed reindex example, and QA smoke.

ali_sdk: Ill take JS + SDK blurb. Plan to use `model_id` in examples and show one-line old->new.

mira_prod: Hosted flip scheduled for 2024-11-21 17:00 UTC. Dedicated customers have a 14-day opt-in. Docs should include dates and opt-in steps.

dev_infra: FYI infra will not auto-convert streaming requests. We'll provide a minimal compat helper for sync calls only. I'll add a 2-line snippet and a clear WARNING.

paul_qa: Tag me on the PR. I'll run smoke: generation, streaming, embeddings, and a reindex run against pgvector. I'll paste a short reindex command for the doc.

sam_docs: Outline: banner copy (soft + firm), quick migration (old vs new), streaming checklist, embed reindex example, FAQ + changelog link. Keep snippets <6 lines.

ali_sdk: Draft changelog line: "SDK: `model` renamed to `model_id`; stricter streaming validation. Update callsites and test streaming flows."

sam_docs: Example (tiny):
```js
// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hi' })
// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hi' })
```

dev_infra: Compat helper (py):
```py
if 'model' in req: req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')
# WARNING: streaming frames NOT handled
```

paul_qa: Reindex pseudo-cmd: `python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src legacy_idx --dst v2_idx --model redwood/v2-embed-xl` + note to update pgvector dim.

sam_docs: Banner suggestions: soft: "Notice: v1 endpoints are on the deprecation path. See migration guide." firm: "Deprecated: v1 endpoints retire on 2025-01-30. Migrate to v2." Use soft on reference pages.

ali_sdk: I'll open the SDK PR with snippets and the blurb (due EOD tomorrow).

paul_qa: I'll run smoke after PR lands and post results.

dev_infra: CI will run docs canary + smoke when branch lands.

deploy-bot: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/v1-to-v2-quick` will run lint + smoke at 2024-11-09T08:00:00Z.

sam_docs: Owners & deadlines:
- ali_sdk: snippets + blurb (EOD tomorrow)
- dev_infra: compat snippet + infra note (Mon)
- paul_qa: smoke plan + reindex example (Mon)
- sam_docs: assemble guide + banners, open PR (Tue AM)

sam_docs: Will ping #docs-review when PR is ready. :rocket:
